text:
Asking rents in Bremen stand at a median of 11.38 €/m² (2026-06), up 2.6% on the year and +25.5% over five years. That ranks Bremen #19 of 37 cities; new lets are priced 47% above the 2022 average contract rent of 7.75 €/m².

A 60 m² flat costs about 683 € a month in cold rent, 15.2% of the disposable income of two residents. Listings stay online for about 26 days and 29% are gone within a week; with 2.0% market-active vacancy and +0.8% population growth over five years, the market looks broadly balanced.

The model estimate for twelve months ahead is 12.09 €/m² (+6.3%), with an 80% range of 11.73 to 12.47 €/m²; housing-loan rates are at 4.01%.
